Migraine.description: A neurological condition causing intense, throbbing headaches often with nausea and sensitivity to light/sound.
tips: Rest in a dark, quiet room
Consult a doctor about triptans for frequent attacks

Allergy.description: Immune response to typically harmless substances (allergens) causing sneezing, itching, or rash.
tips: Seek care for breathing difficulty or swelling

Flu-like Illness.description: Viral illness with fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, and fatigue.
tips: Paracetamol/acetaminophen for fever (if safe for you)
Seek care if breathing difficulty or chest pain

Diabetes.description: A chronic condition affecting how your body turns food into energy, leading to high blood sugar.

Hypertension.description: Elevated blood pressure that can increase risk of heart disease and stroke if uncontrolled.

COVID-19.description: Respiratory viral infection that can cause fever, cough, loss of taste/smell, and breathing issues.
tips: Follow local testing and treatment guidance
Seek urgent care for breathing difficulty
